title: Cockpit mock-up
source: JoyPro's labels, placed on the photo by looking at it (2026-10-31)

labels.note: Extra keys and a small screen under the big display on this mock-up.
The pilot's right hand flies the jet with this short stick at the side.
The left hand pushes this lever forward for more engine power; its buttons work the sensors and weapons.
The striped loop on the seat the pilot pulls to be shot out of the jet in an emergency.
